name: nginx-multisite
description: Provides Nginx web serving for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts with static content, security configuration, Fail2ban, UFW, SSH hardening, sysctl settings, and development self-signed certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, Fedora-compatible runtime and logging directories, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI application with Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, a Git checkout, virtual environment, database and user initialization, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
